messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up: customer has asked for a pilot that supports short burst capacity and HSM-backed keys. Need cross-team plan for scope + launch criteria. Who can own sequencing?
Jin (Eng): We can implement burst handling but runtime needs KV cache adjustments and an async-batcher. Estimate: 2 engineers, ~4 weeks to stabilize. Priya, confirm.
Priya (Runtime): Confirmed. Async batcher + KV policy toggles ~2 sprints. We also need a small harness to simulate long-tail sequence lengths. Can we get a canary pool to validate?
Alex (Infra): Canary pool ok, but infra changes: reserve capacity, autoscale policy, and VPC routing for HSM traffic. I count ~8 dev-days + testing. Need target qps and burst window to size.
Sam (Security): HSM path: if customer requires on-prem HSM, add compliance gap analysis + network DMZ. Otherwise we can integrate cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys. I'll start threat model next Wed.
Nora (PMM): Marketing note: customer expects an SLA-like commitment. For pilot we should label it "pilot SLO" and be explicit about capacity limits.
Maya (Product): Proposed launch gates: 1) customer acceptance tests green; 2) p50 latency <= 150ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool; 3) automated fallback to hosted-compatible model variant; 4) security signoff for keys. Anything missing?
Jin (Eng): Add: perf regression in CI and a chaos test that kills the dedicated pool to ensure fallback works. Also document quantization vs. output-quality tradeoffs in the spec.
Priya (Runtime): Agree. We'll provide a per-tenant pin flag and routing policy for canary rollouts. Need a small canary slice from infra.
Alex (Infra): I'll open INFRA ticket and reserve a slot. Action: product -> expected sustained RPS and burst QPS numbers by EOD so we can size.
Sam (Security): Fallback plan if HSM review slips: require customer-managed KMS + runtime audit logs + accelerated key rotation. I'll draft checklist for approvals.
Maya (Product): Action owners: Jin -> perf test PR + CI gating; Priya -> runtime fallback/canary design; Alex -> infra ticket & autoscale runbook; Sam -> HSM checklist & threat model; Nora -> customer comms draft. I'll update roadmap and share deck.
Jin (Eng): Quick perf command to reproduce locally: `./run_perf --model prefetch-pilot-v1 --tokens 512 --concurrency 8 --dur 60s`
deploy-bot: INFRA-7534 created: reserved window 2024-09-20..2024-09-30 for canary pool testing
Maya (Product): Thanks. I'll post the updated spec in #product-docs after owners confirm. Reconvene next Tue 11am unless blockers. :thumbsup:
Priya (Runtime): One more: runtime tests should include at least one quantized variant and one FP16 so we can measure latency vs. quality delta. I'll add that to the matrix.
Alex (Infra): Sending RPS ask now. If any team needs early access to the canary pool, DM me.
Sam (Security): Note: external auditor availability may delay HSM review. I'll surface options in the security doc.
Maya (Product): Copy. Will track blockers in the roadmap card.
